name: vibe-ticket-tracker
description: Local ticket tracking system for vibe coding — CLI + Express API with MCP support

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist-server/ dist-ui/ node_modules/ && npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.build:ui: cd frontend && npx ng build --configuration production 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui
scripts.prepack: test -d backend/dist && test -d frontend/dist/ui/browser || npm run build; mkdir -p dist-server dist-ui && cp -r backend/dist/* dist-server/ && cp -r frontend/dist/ui/browser/* dist-ui/ && node frontend/scripts/inject-version.mjs dist-ui
scripts.prepublishOnly: test -d backend/dist && test -d frontend/dist/ui/browser || npm run build; mkdir -p dist-server dist-ui && cp -r backend/dist/* dist-server/ && cp -r frontend/dist/ui/browser/* dist-ui/ && node frontend/scripts/inject-version.mjs dist-ui
